user.title: Office
user.description: Join an office that a colleague hosts in their Home Assistant, or host the office here.

member.title: Join an office
member.description: Ask the host for the address of their Home Assistant and a token.

data_description.url: For example https://home.example.com, the address the host reaches Home Assistant on from outside.
data_description.token: The host makes it under Office, Configure, Add a colleague or renew a token.

host.title: Host the office
host.description: Colleagues join with the address of this Home Assistant from outside and a token you make for them.

reauth_confirm.title: New token
reauth_confirm.description: The host no longer knows the token. Ask for a new one.

error.invalid_auth: The host does not know this token.
error.cannot_connect: The host is not reachable at this address.
error.invalid_name: Use a name with letters or numbers.

abort.already_configured: Office is already set up here.

menu_options.add_member: Add a colleague or renew a token

office_days.title: Office days
office_days.description: The days you work at the office. A skip day can only be set on these days, for everyone.

add_member.title: Add a colleague
add_member.description: A name that exists gets a new token and keeps its skip days; the old token stops working.

token.title: Token for {name}
token.description:
Give {name} this token. It is shown only this once.

`{token}`

set_skip_day.name: Set skip day
set_skip_day.description: Sets or clears your own skip day on an office day from today to Sunday next week. The others see it after a minute.

skip.name: Skip
skip.description: On to skip the office that day, off to come after all.
